detail.title: Initiating Inquiry into Accountable Cross-Turn Continuity
detail.summary: Establishing a project to investigate how durable state and constraint enforcement can unify discrete model invocations into an accountable, consistent process, utilizing current evidence on constraint satisfaction and cognitive flow augmentation.

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
detail.question: How can durable state and mechanical constraints enable fresh model invocations to function as a singular, accountable process?
detail.reason: The objective requires reconciling independent, stateless invocations with a durable, verifiable history.

children.title: formal verification of cross-turn state consistency in agentic reasoning systems

detail.reason: To deepen the investigation, I need to look for established methods of formalizing consistency in stateless-to-stateful transition models, moving beyond simple flow augmentation.
